## What

The operator merged PRs #135–#138 into `main`. This PR merges
`origin/main` (`a3c7772`) into the round-4 chain tip so every later
round-4 row builds on the merged truth: one merge commit (`0ca04bb`,
precedent `6392736`), the one textual conflict resolved to main's
derivation-aware ac5 rule, generated artifacts regenerated, the full
suite green.

The merge imports, verbatim from main:

- `foreign/e2-python/` — the E2-candidate foreign implementation
  (`foreign.py`, `answers.json`, `README.md`; PR #136 / HUMAN-H3).
- `crates/hh-xcheck/CHECKER.md` prose corrections (the
  `identify_text` `hir.text`-verbatim fix, `eb9a88d`) — and the
  regenerated `fixtures/cross-impl/CHECKER.md` + `bundle.json` (only
  the `CHECKER.md` member hash moves `704bcf82…` → `fd051879…`; all
  89 arm member hashes unchanged).
- `crates/hh-mcp-lab/tests/r2_19.rs` — the credential_mediator
  zero-ttl deflake (`958f675`/`cd7657c`).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — the seatbelt skip-guards, token-echo
  re-drain, and S2 boundary spike port (`5668d54`); the merged file
  keeps the chain's own ADR-0359 `cargo fetch --locked` block.

## The one conflict — `crates/hh-cli/tests/in_process.rs` (ac5 leg)

Both sides repaired the same ac5 flake (the measured `assembly_ms`
wall cascading into later derived members). The chain carried the
older per-member allowlist (`derived_from.view_hash` + `plan_id`
admitted unconditionally; R3.1/R3.3). Main's `eac030a`/`d9074a4` is
the stricter **derivation-aware** rule: those two members are admitted
only when an upstream `assembly_ms.value`/`assembly_ms.measured_at`
diff is present (`measured_drift`) — it subsumes the chain's members
under a stricter condition. Resolved to main's rule (same precedent
as `6392736`); five comment lines retain the R3.1/R3.3 flake run ids
(38020320703, 38703040017) per the ticket's instruction.

Admitted member set, before → after: `.hash`, `.prev_hash`,
`attendance.value`, `attendance.source`, `idempotency_key`, `decider`,
`reason`, `assembly_ms.value`, `assembly_ms.measured_at` — unchanged;
`derived_from.view_hash`, `.plan_id` — unconditional → gated on
`measured_drift`.
